name: windbg-mcp
description: WinDbg MCP server backed by Microsoft's Windows Debugger Engine.

args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $cache=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'WinDbg-MCP\0.1.3'; $exe=Join-Path $cache 'windbg-mcp.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $cache | Out-Null; $download=Join-Path $cache 'windbg-mcp.exe.download'; $downloadHash=Join-Path $cache 'windbg-mcp.exe.download.sha256'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/zxcvbbq/WinDbg-MCP/releases/download/v0.1.3/windbg-mcp-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe' -OutFile $download; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/zxcvbbq/WinDbg-MCP/releases/download/v0.1.3/windbg-mcp-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe.sha256' -OutFile $downloadHash; $expected=((Get-Content -LiteralPath $downloadHash -Raw).Trim().Split(' ')[0]).ToLowerInvariant(); $actual=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $download -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actual -ne $expected) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $download,$downloadHash -Force; throw 'WinDbg MCP checksum verification failed' }; Move-Item -LiteralPath $download -Destination $exe -Force; Move-Item -LiteralPath $downloadHash -Destination (Join-Path $cache 'windbg-mcp.exe.sha256') -Force }; & $exe
